purpose: Leaf-level provenance contract for parameter handoffs

classification_rules.rule: A selected existing potential's documented identity is FILE, with snapshot/source. The proposal to select it may be CAND, but the file's name/hash is not a new candidate material value.
USER only for an explicit input constraint; preserve original prompt or file reference. A default or assumption is CAND, even if it seems conventional.

classification_rules.field: derived steps, durations, input ratios and increments
classification_rules.rule: CALC with formula and input references; inherited numeric operands keep their own provenance.
RUNTIME until the named upstream asset is available. A proposed size or cell recipe is CAND. Do not replace a missing actual value by its candidate and label FILE.
Label each leaf separately, or split into multiple fields. Never assign a single LIT/FILE/USER status to a dictionary containing candidates or calculations.
Reported paper loading rate and preparation time are LIT. Choosing that time for this run is CAND unless USER locked it. Derived run steps/totals are CALC. Do not mark the whole comparison LIT.
Every ID must exist in reference-index.json. Free descriptive names are labels, not IDs.
